subject.title: [Feature]: Optional session activity watchdog and alerts (blocked by #39127)

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in session activity watchdog and operator alerting surface after the session activity API lands, or should core expose activity/diagnostic signals for plugins and dashboards to consume?
rationale: The request adds feature, config, delivery, privacy, UI/operator, and optional model-call behavior rather than repairing an existing contract, so automation cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Design Core Watchdog After Activity API
options.body: Keep this open as the downstream product/design item once the canonical sessions.activity contract is settled.

options.title: Route Alerts To Plugins Or Dashboards
options.body: Close or redirect this if maintainers want core to expose activity and diagnostics only while plugin/dashboard surfaces handle alert delivery.

options.title: Narrow To Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep improving stuck/stalled diagnostics and recovery without adding an operator alerting product surface yet.

recommendation.title: Design Core Watchdog After Activity API
recommendation.body: Keep this open as the downstream product/design item once the canonical sessions.activity contract is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current routing signal for the canonical gateway session activity/protocol decision that this watchdog depends on.
